highlights.description: Spec workflow single source of truth — specification-workflow-spec's catalog (~25 profiles) is now the only workflow definition source; VisionStudio's divergent local catalog was retired, a workflow can be switched after creation, and the Initiative page adapts to whichever workflow is assigned

Authentic AWS Working Backwards — aws-one-way-door/aws-two-way-door profiles reordered to be PR-first per actual Amazon practice and infused with the 16 Leadership Principles, alongside the dashboard's first web mutation (New Initiative creation, POST /api/initiatives)

Registry & RMI lifecycle CLI — repository records can be updated, archived with supersession, removed, and health-checked (registry doctor); RMIs can be bulk-reassigned across repositories as one auditable operation

Release tracking system — a Release entity with initiative/RMI/repository edges, a full release CLI (plan/record/list/show/attach/detach/delete/backfill-match), a changelog gate, an unshipped-initiatives queue, and CHANGELOG.json/git-tag/GitHub-Releases ingest — the very system used to prepare this release
Registry org/person/visibility modeling — Organization and Person entities, GitHub-derived repository visibility, and a publicrail export safety rail gating what any public roadmap view can ever show
Reversible initiative lifecycle — an initiative can reopen to any earlier pipeline status as scope evolves, with later-stage lifecycle timestamps cleared so history stays truthful
VisionStudio Cloud groundwork (dogfood-only) — local tenant-assignment config and a whole-database sync command over godolt

added.description: Organization and Person entities with idempotent org backfill from repository organization strings, person upsert with org affiliations, registry org/person CLI commands, and a DeleteSpecWorkflow store method
Repository.visibility (public|private|unknown) ingested from GitHub via gh; registry visibility refresh command and a VIS column in registry list
publicrail package — the single implementation of the export predicate for all external projections (static export, cloud serving), gated on explicit repo/initiative visibility flags
registry per-org, private-focus, and practitioner query slices for portfolio views

specification-workflow-spec consumed as the single source of truth for spec workflows: SyncFromCatalog upserts the DB index, remaps retired IDs, deletes unreferenced rows (workflow seed deprecated as an alias); GetSynthesisGuidance falls back to prompt_context
quick-fix workflow profile upstream in specification-workflow-spec (extends pbhq-lite; ROADMAP-only required)

workflowId and file roles (required/optional/extra) in the execution + spec-file API responses, workflow detail (sequence/phases) in /api/specs, POST /api/initiatives (first API mutation endpoint, validates ID/title/workflow, 409 on duplicates), and GET /api/workflows/{id}/specs/{type} serving the embedded template + rubric

initiative update --workflow <id> to switch an initiative's spec workflow after creation, keeping the synthesis/eval workflow-selection record in step; workflow list/get/sync read from the catalog; create-time workflow validation; workflow column in initiative list/get

Workflow-driven Initiative UI: spec set/progress/tab order/diagram derived from the assigned workflow instead of hardcoded PBHQ-Lite; New Initiative creation modal with catalog workflow dropdown, per-workflow required-docs preview, and type-driven defaults; a read-only workflow chip and a template + LLM-as-a-Judge rubric viewer on the Definition tab; Extra badges on non-workflow files
Release Ent entity (version, changelog, commit hash, release notes) with edges to Initiative, RoadmapItem, and Repository
Backwards initiative lifecycle transitions: reopening to an earlier pipeline stage clears every later-stage timestamp (e.g. reopening to executing clears DeliveryCompleteAt)

release CLI — plan/record/list/show/attach/detach/delete over the Release entity; a changelog gate that checks/scaffolds CHANGELOG.json entries at record time; release unshipped surfaces initiatives claiming delivery with no release attached (a 14-day forcing function); release backfill-match reviews AI-assisted matches between historical commits/tags and initiatives for confirmation
CHANGELOG.json/git-tag ingest with a trailer-coverage report, backfilling Release records and associating them with initiatives via commit trailer chains
GitHub Releases API as a release source, closing the gap between local git tags and real GitHub Release history (ingest github-releases, ingest releases)
visionstudio cloud — client-side config recording which VisionStudio Cloud tenant a local install is assigned to
visionstudio sync — whole-database push to a VisionStudio Cloud tenant over godolt (dogfood-only)
Repository.SupersededBy field and a store-level DeleteRepository, the groundwork for registry archive/remove
Short repository name resolution (bare name, org/name, or full ID) in registry and rmi commands, with a did-you-mean suggestion on no/ambiguous match
registry update <repo-id> to repoint/edit an existing entry's path/org/branch/name
registry archive <repo-id> — status change preserving the record, with --superseded-by pointing at a replacement repository
registry remove <repo-id> — hard delete for true mistakes, refusing while RMIs/releases/spec documents still reference the repository
registry add conflict/duplicate detection — warns on a --path that's missing or not a git working tree, and on a path or git remote collision with an existing entry
rmi bulk-update --repo --set-repo — reassign every RMI on a repository in one call, with a --dry-run preview
registry doctor — flags a missing directory, a non-git working tree, or a git remote origin URL that no longer matches the registered ID, across every non-archived repository
registry archive --superseded-by --reassign-rmis — folds RMI reassignment and the archive status change into one auditable operation
--format json on rmi list/get, initiative list/get, and registry list/get
initiative list --repo/--status/--program filters

changed.description: Default workflow by initiative type: maintenance/refactor/migration→quick-fix, feature/compliance/default→pbhq-lite (pbhq-standard retired; canonical upstream pbhq-lite requires all four docs)

Profiles gain iteration_trigger on the PR/FAQ, prfaq_review gates, a required decision_meeting gate for aws-one-way-door, an evidence-appendix section in press templates, and spike-backed feasibility prompts in FAQ templates (upstream)

AWS Working Backwards profiles renamed by Amazon's actual selection criterion, decision reversibility: aws-product→aws-one-way-door, aws-feature→aws-two-way-door (workflow sync remaps existing initiatives); scale and door decoupled, with MRD and OpportunitySpec optional in both profiles (upstream)

Amazon Leadership Principles infused into the AWS door workflows: the full 16-principle set in both profiles' methodology metadata, LP guidance in press/FAQ/6-pager templates, and LP-grounded rubric categories (upstream)
workflow list/get read from the catalog (with sequence/phase detail) instead of DB rows; deterministic execution-sequence ordering

highlights.description: The pivot: a new Go CLI + web dashboard (`visionstudio`) for cross-repository roadmap execution — Programs -> Initiatives -> Phases -> RMIs, backed by Dolt — alongside the existing spec-authoring system, superseding the Electron desktop app and cmd/daemon as the primary surface
Renamed the binary and module entry point from `vistudio` to `visionstudio` (breaking)
One-command startup (`visionstudio app start`), an embedded web SPA (go:embed, no external files needed), and actionable DB-down diagnostics instead of raw driver errors
Programs, initiatives, and now individual initiatives can each be hidden from the dashboard, with hiding a program cascading to its initiatives everywhere they're listed

Real path-traversal fixes, not just lint suppressions: the spec-files endpoint and 12 separate CodeQL alerts across cmd/daemon, closed using a validation pattern upstreamed to the shared grokify/mogo library (ValidatePathComponent/JoinSecure/FindFirstExistingSecure) rather than duplicated locally

Full documentation overhaul: README/installation/quickstart now lead with the visionstudio CLI, the Electron/daemon path is explicitly marked legacy, and six new dashboard user-guide pages cover every panel

web/: Vite + React SPA scaffold with a shared UI toolkit and chart primitives
Execution, Spend, Maturity, Specs, and composed four-quadrant InitiativeView panels

pkg/apitypes Go-first type pipeline (Go structs -> JSON Schema -> Zod -> TypeScript) plus Repositories and Performance dashboard panels
`visionstudio app start/status/stop`, `visionstudio ui`, and `visionstudio db` lifecycle commands for one-command startup; embedded web SPA via go:embed

security.description: Upstreamed ValidatePathComponent (allowlist regex) and JoinSecure (filepath.Rel/filepath.IsAbs containment check) to github.com/grokify/mogo's os/osutil, rather than a repo-local package -- verified against a live CodeQL scan that this specific idiom is what the go/path-injection query recognizes as a sanitizer, unlike a strings.HasPrefix check wrapped in a helper function

dependencies.description: Upgrade `github.com/ProductBuildersHQ/visionspec` to v0.14.0 (was v0.13.0). Breaking change upstream: `pkg/rubrics` drops its VisionSpec-local `RubricSet`/`Category`/`CategoricalCriteria` types in favor of `structured-evaluation/rubric.RubricSet`, and legacy flat rubric YAML is no longer parsed. VisionStudio doesn't import `pkg/rubrics` directly and ships no custom rubric YAML, so this required no code changes — verified with go vet, golangci-lint, and a live daemon run against the profiles endpoint
